leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define a TypeScript interface to structure request deduplication data with appropriate properties
Implement a Map data structure to store and retrieve pending requests by unique identifiers
Apply conditional logic to check for existing identical requests before initiating new ones
Construct a deduplication function that accepts request parameters and returns cached promises
Utilize async/await syntax to handle asynchronous request operations within the deduplication logic
Execute promise resolution to return cached results when duplicate requests are detected
Modify request handling to store new promises in the cache when no duplicates exist
Control cache cleanup by implementing logic to remove completed requests from storage
Invoke the deduplication function within a React component to manage API calls efficiently
Return appropriate error handling within the deduplication mechanism for failed requests
Apply TypeScript generics to create a reusable deduplication utility that works with various request types
Implement a custom hook to encapsulate request deduplication logic for use across multiple components
